governing_outcome: UAOS should discover useful missing capabilities before incidents and carry justified improvements through one evidence-traced governed transaction without relying on repeated user reminders or disconnected helper-local lifecycle steps.

supported_contributing_causes.evidence: Maintenance timing/admission, proposal transition, promotion gating and self-change orchestration were split across helper modules with no single executable owning discovery through post-promotion observation.
ChangeProposal previously required failure-class or evaluated-knowledge origin and could not represent a newly discovered latent capability gap directly.

Direct-main maintenance mutation and inherited progress omission occurred in native ChatGPT despite repository policy/runtime gates; native response/tool paths are not verified as physically mediated.
Repairable gaps were twice reported/recorded without continuing repair until the user explicitly demanded it, despite existing problem-to-action policy.

architecture_candidates.reason: Would automate the old fragmented lifecycle without solving origin/ownership gaps.
Local guards do not establish one owner for the full evolution transaction.
Independent production evidence still supports authority routing, continuity, domain health and other unrelated control surfaces.
One canonical transaction directly closes the evidenced ownership and origin-model defects while reusing lower-level helper mechanisms and existing promotion/action authority.

method_evidence: NIST AI RMF ongoing monitoring and periodic review supports non-incident-only review.
ISO/IEC 42001 continual improvement supports recurring adaptation rather than one-off correction.
SEI ATAM supports goal/scenario/risk/tradeoff architecture evaluation rather than preserving familiar structure.

User-provided Felix Rieseberg height/breadth/depth method was treated as an evaluation candidate: height -> governing outcome; breadth -> multi-lens outside-in discovery; depth -> raw evidence, professional methods/tools, novelty probes and external judge. Stretch targets were bounded by feasibility evidence rather than model insistence.
assurance_boundary: The repository enforces EvolutionTransaction in controlled paths that invoke it. Native ChatGPT has no verified repository-controlled pre-send or pre-tool hook. A periodic proactive trigger exists only when a real host scheduler/ChatGPT Automation is configured; kernel policy alone does not create background execution.
remaining_scope: Configure the approved real ChatGPT periodic proactive capability audit outside repository authority.
Continue production observation for unknown future failure classes.
Do not overstate child-domain adoption until each child independently adopts and verifies the new common capability contract.
